ca_upper_shooting_gallery.blurb: Upper Shooting Gallery is a small cliff in the Trinity Arêtes of Northwest California, one section of the larger Shooting Gallery. It has seven routes: six bolted sport lines and a single trad climb. Five of them sit in the 5.10 range and two reach 5.11, so it suits leaders who are already comfortable on low double-digit grades. Rock quality is uneven, mediocre on some lines and excellent on others. The slope below the wall is steep and loose, and stones that come down tend to funnel toward the lower wall, so helmets matter and parties should keep track of who is above whom. Reaching the base involves a trail with fixed ropes up the left side.

ca_school_yard_area_the.blurb: The School Yard Area is a hillside group of roped climbs on Mount Woodson in northern San Diego County. The mountain is best known for its boulders, but this section is about gear and top-rope climbing. It has seven routes: six trad lines and one top-rope line, and several of the trad routes can also be top-roped. Grades start at 5.9 for two routes, then three sit at 5.11 and two at 5.12, which makes it a better fit for climbers working in the upper grades than for beginners. The hillside is reached from the road that runs up Woodson.

ca_bush_dome.blurb: Bush Dome is a small formation among the Lost Horse Roadside Crags in Joshua Tree National Park, at roughly 4,100 feet. The climbing is on its east side. It has seven routes, six of them trad and one bolted, with grades running from 5.6 through the 5.10s to a single 5.11. That spread gives beginners a couple of moderate leads and leaves harder crack routes for stronger climbers. Some of the stone is weak, but solid lines exist, so test holds and gear placements as you go. Mel's Diner, a neighboring formation, sits along the way in.

ca_8_sun_wall_area.blurb: Sun Wall Area is a section at the far end of The Fortress, a cliff in Woodfords Canyon off Highway 88 near Carson Pass in the Lake Tahoe region. It sits between the Winter Prime and Red Pillar walls. All seven routes are trad, with two at 5.9, three in the 5.10 range and two at 5.11. The lines are sustained, with jamming and some offwidth, and one of them is about 95 feet long. Carry a full rack that goes up to 3 or 4 inches. Higher on the wall the rock can be dirty and flaky, so expect to clean as you climb.

ca_4_sunset_wall.blurb: Sunset Wall is one sector of Marble Caves, a limestone crag on a ridge above the South Fork of the Trinity River in Northwest California. It has seven routes: six sport climbs and one trad line. Grades span 5.8 to 5.12, with three at 5.10, one at 5.11 and two at 5.12, so there is a moderate warm-up and a handful of harder lines. The wall lies just beyond Dream Wall. The way up to it is a steep gully with loose rock, and climbers are advised to go through it one at a time rather than stacked on each other.

_expect.name: Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne Routes

ca_grand_canyon_of_the_tuolumne_climbs.blurb: The Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne is the gorge the Tuolumne River cuts below Glen Aulin in Yosemite National Park, stretching about 30 miles down toward Pate Valley. Climbing here is traditional and little documented: old bolts and pins turn up on some walls. Seven trad routes fall between 5.10 and 5.12, with two at 5.10, three at 5.11 and two at 5.12. Getting in means walking roughly 5 miles from Tuolumne Meadows to Glen Aulin and then following the river, so this is a commitment rather than a quick crag day.

ca_punk_rock_west_face.blurb: Punk Rock (West Face) is the largest face of a dome above Courtright Reservoir, on the western slope of the southern Sierra Nevada at about 8,300 feet. It has seven routes: four trad, two sport and one alpine-style line. Grades run from 5.10 to 5.13, with three at 5.10, two at 5.11, one at 5.12 and one at 5.13. The left and central parts of the face are steep and sparsely featured, while the lower-angled right end holds the easier climbing. The walk from the paved lot takes about 5 to 15 minutes depending on which part of the face you are heading for.
